subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona-level TTS SecretRef collection merge before the optional TTS SecretRef startup-degradation work is resolved?
rationale: This PR fixes a real credential-resolution gap but also expands active fail-closed SecretRef resolution to persona-level TTS keys, overlapping the open optional-TTS startup-failure work.

options.title: Merge after optional-TTS degradation
options.body: Wait for or co-land an equivalent of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265 so newly collected persona TTS refs do not turn missing optional keys into startup failures.

options.title: Accept current fail-closed behavior
options.body: Land this as a credential-resolution fix and explicitly accept that missing persona TTS SecretRefs may fail active runtime startup until a follow-up lands.

options.title: Pause for a narrower contract decision
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the optional-key behavior settled before expanding supported persona-level TTS SecretRef targets.

recommendation.title: Merge after optional-TTS degradation
recommendation.body: Wait for or co-land an equivalent of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265 so newly collected persona TTS refs do not turn missing optional keys into startup failures.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the broad SecretRef rollout and is the strongest history signal for upgrade-sensitive credential-resolution decisions in this area.
